name: ViVerBench
intro: ViVerBench 是 Seed2.0 报告中使用的视觉理解 benchmark，用于评估模型在通用视觉任务上的表现。
build_method: 人工标注、程序生成与增强开放数据，真假平衡视觉验证题
metric: Rule-based Label Accuracy, Model-based Explanation Validity
build_method_en: Manual annotation, programmatic generation, and augmented open data with balanced true/false verification items
intro_en: ViVerBench is a visual understanding benchmark used by the Seed2.0 report for evaluating general vision tasks.
metric_en: Rule-based Label Accuracy, Model-based Explanation Validity

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ViVerBench ICLR 2026 paper, Section 3 and Appendix A. ViVerBench combines manual annotation, programmatic generation, and augmented open data to create balanced true/false visual-verification items across 16 tasks and six categories. Rule-based scoring checks labels, while model-based scoring also evaluates the validity of explanations for false claims.
